title: The band
detail: Always above the prompt: kane-cli is idle, and row 3 is requirement coverage. Nothing to start.

title: Claude runs a test, the band follows
detail: Ask Claude; within two seconds the band shows the run, its time and the step it is on. The mascot moves while it runs.

title: The pane: runs and steps
detail: /kane opens it. Press a run for its steps with their times.

title: Several runs at once, and a failure
detail: Runs started anywhere in this project: one cell per run, what is running now; a failure takes row 2 the moment it happens.

title: Why it failed
detail: kane’s own verdict: why, what kind, how sure, where; the steps; Open evidence.

title: A suite
detail: kane-cli testrun: one cell per test, done · running · left; one row per test in the pane.

title: After Claude changes code
detail: An edit and no test since: the band warns. The card offers the saved test that covers it, with its last result.

title: Test the change
detail: Run it hands the saved test to Claude; when the run ends, the warning clears.

title: Assurance
detail: Designed and proven coverage from kane-cli cover gaps, and what each use case still owes.

title: End
detail: kane-qe v2: a band that watches kane-cli, a pane for runs and assurance, and a nudge to test what Claude changed.
